decisions: Derive source module/symbol, parameter templates and ordered template-to-actual constraints from actual Typed IR plans; no injected CSharp function strings.
Infer each declared parameter through the same structural type substitution used by Typed IR, requiring a complete concrete environment.
Keep IR adaptation separate from the stable fact model; existing source collectors borrow the original type graph and specializations borrow the expanded graph.
Retain template generic names/constraints/type syntax and substitute bound primary/return/additional types plus ordered specialization types.
Generate concrete names using native-registered semantic type identities; unregistered composite arguments remain pending rather than falling back to IR offsets or ABI names.
Repeated calls with identical bound environments contribute one function identity.

CSharp constructor syntax is parsed in its active generic environment before global aliases; the native typed generic body materialization already uses structural substitutions rather than global spelling aliases.
remaining: Composite generic argument registration and full function fact collection
Production emitter consumption and cache lookup/reuse/publication
Full SLG program compilation/runtime is not proven by metadata components
